```{python}
# The report only reads dbt models: business rules stay in dbt, never here.
import duckdb
import plotly.graph_objects as go
from IPython.display import HTML, Markdown, display

con = duckdb.connect("../data/saas.duckdb", read_only=True)

MONTHS = ["janvier", "février", "mars", "avril", "mai", "juin", "juillet", "août", "septembre", "octobre", "novembre", "décembre"]
BLUE = "#0072b2"
ORANGE = "#c2410c"
plotly_loaded = False


def euros(value):
    return f"{value:,.0f}".replace(",", " ") + " €"


def signed_euros(value):
    return f"{value:+,.0f}".replace(",", " ") + " €"


def percent(value):
    return f"{value * 100:.1f}".replace(".", ",") + " %"


def month_name(day):
    return MONTHS[day.month - 1]


def long_date(day):
    return f"{day.day} {month_name(day)} {day.year}"


def in_months(words):
    return "en " + words[0] if len(words) == 1 else "en " + ", en ".join(words[:-1]) + " et en " + words[-1]


def of_month(day):
    name = month_name(day)
    return f"d'{name}" if name[0] in "aeio" else f"de {name}"


def favorable_pattern(flags):
    # Hatching repeats what color says, so unfavorable bars stay visible without color.
    return dict(shape=["" if flag else "/" for flag in flags], fgcolor="white", size=7, solidity=0.25)


def show_chart(figure, description):
    # Plotly's script loads once, with the first chart of the page.
    global plotly_loaded
    figure.update_layout(template="plotly_white", separators=", ", margin=dict(l=10, r=10, t=30, b=10))
    chart = figure.to_html(
        full_html=False,
        include_plotlyjs=False if plotly_loaded else "cdn",
        config={"displayModeBar": False, "responsive": True},
    )
    plotly_loaded = True
    display(HTML(f'<div role="img" aria-label="{description}">{chart}</div>'))


budget = con.execute("""
    select
        budget_month,
        billed_amount_eur,
        budget_billed_eur,
        billed_variance_eur,
        closing_mrr_eur,
        budget_closing_mrr_eur,
        mrr_variance_eur
    from analytics_marts.mart_budget_vs_actual
    order by budget_month
""").fetchall()
movements = con.execute("""
    select
        mrr_month,
        opening_mrr_eur,
        new_mrr_eur + expansion_mrr_eur + reactivation_mrr_eur as gained_eur,
        contraction_mrr_eur + churned_mrr_eur as lost_eur,
        closing_mrr_eur,
        closing_customer_count,
        gross_mrr_churn_rate
    from analytics_marts.mart_monthly_mrr
    order by mrr_month
""").fetchall()
customers = con.execute("""
    select d.customer_name, sum(b.billed_amount_eur) as billed_amount_eur
    from analytics_marts.mart_customer_monthly_billing as b
    inner join analytics_marts.dim_customers as d
        on b.customer_id = d.customer_id
    group by 1
    order by 2
""").fetchall()
open_invoices = con.execute("""
    select d.customer_name, o.invoice_date, o.due_date, o.amount_eur, o.days_overdue, o.aging_bucket, o.closing_date
    from analytics_marts.mart_open_invoices as o
    inner join analytics_marts.dim_customers as d
        on o.customer_id = d.customer_id
    order by o.days_overdue desc, o.invoice_date, d.customer_name
""").fetchall()
payments = con.execute("""
    select d.customer_name, p.paid_invoice_count, p.total_days_to_pay, p.avg_days_to_pay, p.late_paid_invoice_count
    from analytics_marts.mart_customer_payment_behavior as p
    inner join analytics_marts.dim_customers as d
        on p.customer_id = d.customer_id
    order by p.avg_days_to_pay
""").fetchall()
term_days = con.execute("select max(due_date - invoice_date) from analytics_marts.fct_invoices").fetchone()[0]

first_month, last_month = budget[0], budget[-1]
total_billed = sum(row[1] for row in budget)
total_budget = sum(row[2] for row in budget)
total_variance = sum(row[3] for row in budget)
worst_billed = min(budget, key=lambda row: row[3])
worst_churn = min(movements, key=lambda row: row[3])
largest_mrr_gap = min(row[6] for row in budget)
gap_months = [row for row in budget if row[6] == largest_mrr_gap]
open_total = sum(invoice[3] for invoice in open_invoices)
overdue_total = sum(invoice[3] for invoice in open_invoices if invoice[4] > 0)
paid_count = sum(row[1] for row in payments)
late_count = sum(row[4] for row in payments)
average_days = sum(row[2] for row in payments) / paid_count
top_name, top_amount = customers[-1]
closing_date = open_invoices[0][6]

display(HTML(
    f'<p class="report-period">De {month_name(first_month[0])} à {month_name(last_month[0])} {last_month[0].year}, données fictives</p>'
))

tiles = [
    ("CA facturé HT", euros(total_billed)),
    (f"MRR fin {month_name(last_month[0])}", euros(last_month[4])),
    ("Créances échues", euros(overdue_total)),
    ("Délai moyen de paiement", f"{average_days:.0f} jours"),
]
display(HTML(
    '<div class="tiles">'
    + "".join(f'<div class="tile"><div class="tile-label">{label}</div><div class="tile-value">{value}</div></div>' for label, value in tiles)
    + "</div>"
))

churn_sentence = ""
if worst_churn[3] < 0:
    churn_sentence = f" Le churn {of_month(worst_churn[0])} coûte {euros(-worst_churn[3])} de MRR ({percent(worst_churn[6])})"
    churn_sentence += ", compensé par le MRR gagné sur le mois." if worst_churn[2] >= -worst_churn[3] else "."

attention = ""
if largest_mrr_gap < 0:
    months = in_months([month_name(row[0]) for row in gap_months])
    attention = f"\n- **Point d'attention.** L'écart de MRR au budget est le plus marqué {months}, à {signed_euros(largest_mrr_gap)}."
    masked = [month_name(row[0]) for row in gap_months if row[3] >= 0]
    if masked:
        attention += f" {in_months(masked).capitalize()}, les factures ponctuelles masquent cet écart dans le CA."

display(Markdown(f"""
## Synthèse

- **Activité.** Le CA facturé HT atteint {euros(total_billed)}, soit {percent(total_billed / total_budget)} du budget.
- **Revenu récurrent.** Le MRR termine {month_name(last_month[0])} à {euros(last_month[4])}, soit {percent(last_month[4] / last_month[5])} de l'objectif.{churn_sentence}{attention}
- **Encaissements.** L'encours client s'élève à {euros(open_total)}, dont {euros(overdue_total)} de créances échues ({percent(overdue_total / open_total)}).
"""))
```

## Réalisé par rapport au budget

```{python}
direction = "dépasse le budget" if total_variance >= 0 else "reste sous le budget"
display(Markdown(
    f"Le CA facturé {direction} de {euros(abs(total_variance))} sur la période. "
    f"L'écart le plus défavorable est en {month_name(worst_billed[0])}, à {signed_euros(worst_billed[3])}. "
    "Les barres hachurées signalent les mois sous le budget."
))

figure = go.Figure()
figure.add_bar(
    x=[month_name(row[0]) for row in budget],
    y=[float(row[3]) for row in budget],
    marker=dict(
        color=[BLUE if row[3] >= 0 else ORANGE for row in budget],
        pattern=favorable_pattern([row[3] >= 0 for row in budget]),
        cornerradius=4,
    ),
    text=[signed_euros(row[3]) for row in budget],
    textposition="outside",
    cliponaxis=False,
    hovertemplate="%{x} : %{y:+,.0f} €<extra></extra>",
)
figure.update_layout(height=300, yaxis=dict(ticksuffix=" €", zeroline=True, zerolinecolor="#898781", zerolinewidth=1))
show_chart(figure, "Barres de l'écart mensuel entre le CA facturé et le budget")

table = [
    "| Mois | CA facturé | Budget | Écart | MRR | Budget | Écart |",
    "|:---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|",
]
for row in budget:
    table.append(f"| {month_name(row[0]).capitalize()} | {euros(row[1])} | {euros(row[2])} | {signed_euros(row[3])} | {euros(row[4])} | {euros(row[5])} | {signed_euros(row[6])} |")
table.append(f"| **Total** | **{euros(total_billed)}** | **{euros(total_budget)}** | **{signed_euros(total_variance)}** | | | |")
display(Markdown("\n".join(table)))
```

## CA facturé et revenu récurrent

```{python}
gaps = [f"{month_name(row[0])} ({euros(row[1] - row[4])})" for row in budget if row[1] > row[4]]

display(Markdown(
    "Le MRR ne retient que les abonnements, alors que le CA facturé inclut aussi les factures ponctuelles. "
    f"L'écart apparaît {in_months(gaps)}."
))

labels = [month_name(row[0]) for row in budget]
figure = go.Figure()
figure.add_scatter(x=labels, y=[float(row[1]) for row in budget], name="CA facturé", mode="lines+markers", line=dict(color=BLUE, width=2), marker=dict(symbol="circle", size=8), hovertemplate="%{y:,.0f} €")
figure.add_scatter(x=labels, y=[float(row[4]) for row in budget], name="MRR", mode="lines+markers", line=dict(color=ORANGE, width=2, dash="dash"), marker=dict(symbol="square", size=8), hovertemplate="%{y:,.0f} €")
figure.update_layout(height=320, hovermode="x unified", yaxis=dict(rangemode="tozero", ticksuffix=" €"), legend=dict(orientation="h", y=1.12))
show_chart(figure, "Courbes mensuelles du CA facturé et du MRR")
```

## Évolution du MRR

```{python}
display(Markdown(
    f"Le MRR passe de {euros(movements[0][4])} fin {month_name(movements[0][0])} à {euros(movements[-1][4])} fin {month_name(movements[-1][0])}. "
    "Un total stable peut masquer un départ : il faut lire le MRR perdu et le churn brut, pas seulement la clôture."
))

table = [
    "| Mois | Ouverture | MRR gagné | MRR perdu | Clôture | Clients | Churn brut |",
    "|:---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|",
]
for row in movements:
    churn = "n/a" if row[6] is None else percent(row[6])
    table.append(f"| {month_name(row[0]).capitalize()} | {euros(row[1])} | {euros(row[2])} | {euros(row[3])} | {euros(row[4])} | {row[5]} | {churn} |")
display(Markdown("\n".join(table)))
```

## Concentration du CA

```{python}
display(Markdown(f"{top_name} représente {percent(top_amount / total_billed)} du CA facturé sur la période."))

figure = go.Figure()
figure.add_bar(
    x=[float(customer[1]) for customer in customers],
    y=[customer[0] for customer in customers],
    orientation="h",
    marker=dict(color=BLUE, cornerradius=4),
    text=[euros(customer[1]) for customer in customers],
    textposition="outside",
    cliponaxis=False,
    hovertemplate="%{y} : %{x:,.0f} €<extra></extra>",
)
figure.update_layout(height=300, xaxis=dict(visible=False, range=[0, float(top_amount) * 1.18]), yaxis=dict(automargin=True))
show_chart(figure, "Barres du CA facturé par client")
```

## Encours client et balance âgée

```{python}
display(Markdown(
    f"Au {long_date(closing_date)}, l'encours client s'élève à {euros(open_total)}, dont {euros(overdue_total)} de créances échues."
))

buckets = {
    "not_due": "Non échu",
    "1_30_days": "Échu de 1 à 30 jours",
    "31_60_days": "Échu de 31 à 60 jours",
    "61_90_days": "Échu de 61 à 90 jours",
    "over_90_days": "Échu de plus de 90 jours",
}
table = ["| Ancienneté | Factures | Montant |", "|:---|---:|---:|"]
for bucket, label in buckets.items():
    amounts = [invoice[3] for invoice in open_invoices if invoice[5] == bucket]
    table.append(f"| {label} | {len(amounts)} | {euros(sum(amounts))} |")
table.append(f"| **Total** | **{len(open_invoices)}** | **{euros(open_total)}** |")
display(Markdown("\n".join(table)))
```

```{python}
table = ["| Client | Date de facture | Échéance | Montant | Retard |", "|:---|:---|:---|---:|---:|"]
for name, invoice_date, due, amount, days_overdue, _, _ in open_invoices:
    delay = f"{days_overdue} jours" if days_overdue > 0 else "Non échue"
    table.append(f"| {name} | {long_date(invoice_date)} | {long_date(due)} | {euros(amount)} | {delay} |")
display(Markdown("\n".join(table)))
```

## Délais de paiement

```{python}
display(Markdown(
    f"Les clients règlent en {average_days:.0f} jours en moyenne, pour une échéance à {term_days} jours. "
    f"{percent(late_count / paid_count)} des factures réglées l'ont été après échéance. "
    "Les barres hachurées signalent les clients dont le délai moyen dépasse l'échéance."
))

figure = go.Figure()
figure.add_bar(
    x=[float(row[3]) for row in payments],
    # The delay sits in the axis label, so it stays readable whatever the bar color.
    y=[f"{row[0]}, {row[3]:.0f} jours" for row in payments],
    orientation="h",
    marker=dict(
        color=[ORANGE if row[3] > term_days else BLUE for row in payments],
        pattern=favorable_pattern([row[3] <= term_days for row in payments]),
        cornerradius=4,
    ),
    hovertemplate="%{y}<extra></extra>",
)
figure.add_vline(x=term_days, line=dict(color="#52514e", width=1, dash="dash"), annotation_text="Échéance", annotation_position="top")
figure.update_layout(height=300, xaxis=dict(visible=False, range=[0, float(payments[-1][3]) * 1.05]), yaxis=dict(automargin=True))
show_chart(figure, "Barres du délai moyen de paiement par client, avec l'échéance en repère")
```

## Définitions

- **CA facturé HT :** montant des factures payées ou en attente, hors factures annulées.
- **MRR :** prix mensuel des abonnements actifs le dernier jour du mois.
- **Churn brut :** MRR perdu sur le mois, rapporté au MRR d'ouverture.
- **Encours client :** factures émises et non réglées à la date d'arrêt.
- **Créance échue :** facture non réglée dont l'échéance est dépassée à la date d'arrêt.
